meta.title: Snowflake Premier & Select Partner
meta.description: A Snowflake Premier & Select Partner and CoCo Preferred Partner: certified depth on governed data and the agents that run on it, delivered across the USA and LATAM.

hero.title: One partner network. <hl>One team</hl> that answers for the build.
hero.description: Snowflake is the platform: governed data, Cortex AI and Cortex Agents, all inside one perimeter. Viewnear holds Premier & Select standing in that network and builds agentic solutions that start with the right data.

comparisonHeading.title: Three ways to get there
comparisonHeading.intro: Every leader weighs building in-house, hiring a global systems integrator, or partnering with a specialist. Here is where the three models differ.

comparison.inhouse: Hiring and ramping a team before the build starts
comparison.big3: Mobilization through a large delivery process
comparison.viewnear: 8–16 weeks to first value, demos every sprint

comparison.inhouse: Whoever can be hired and retained
comparison.big3: Staffed from a large bench, often in layers

comparison.inhouse: Learned on the job, funded in-house
comparison.big3: One of many platforms they cover
comparison.viewnear: Premier & Select Partner specialists, end to end

comparison.inhouse: Pilots on whichever model the team already knows
comparison.big3: One of several AI practices, staffed per account
comparison.viewnear: Cortex Agents in production, inside the same governed perimeter

comparison.big3: Often split across practices and subcontractors
comparison.viewnear: One team, owned start to finish

comparison.big3: The engagement continues at day rates
comparison.viewnear: Documented and run: by the team, or by Viewnear as a managed service

cta.title: Put a certified partner on it.
cta.subtitle: Tell us where the organization stands, whether that is Snowflake procurement, a migration, or a process that should be running with an agent, and we'll bring the certified team to move it forward.

snowflake.body: Premier & Select Partner and CoCo Preferred Partner. Migrations, governed foundations, and Cortex AI through Cortex AI Gateway, delivered by SnowPro-certified architects and engineers.
